intro.text: Heeheehee! A dreamer! Fresh, too — still smells of pillow. Come closer, little one. Closer. I only have two teeth, see? Hardly enough to bite anybody. Hardly.

back.text: Smart! Smart dreamer. Smart ones live longest in Crookhollow. Come back when you need a brew — Mother Grizzleroot's brews fix everything. Mostly.

who.text: Mother Grizzleroot, witch of Crookhollow, brewer of the bitter and the bubbling. The houses here lean because they're listening. The other crones? Ooh, they've gone hollow, like the sporelings. They'll hex you for your teeth.

options.text: Hollow? Like the sporeling I saw?

hollow.text: Something under the meadow is drinking the dreams. Crones, gremlins, sporelings — all going empty. Bring me their teeth and cogs, dreamer. A witch can't brew from nothing.

greet.text: Back again, dreamer? The cauldron missed you. It told me. It tells me everything.

teeth.text: Ooooh. Three of them! Long and yellow, just how I like. Here — a tea for your trouble. Don't drink it near the moon. It notices.
